# WireDash AI contributor contract

Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) before any modification. The exact supported install AND update command is:

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/smorad3363/WireDash/main/install.sh | sudo bash
```

Never split installation and update into different commands. Keep the entrypoint, README.md, docs/INSTALL.md, pinned build workflow, smoke tests, preservation of volumes and rollback consistent.
